modern_lobby.title: Reserve your country
modern_lobby.instructions: Preview a country using the map, search or list, then reserve it. Each playing participant needs a different country. Unselected countries are controlled by AI.
modern_lobby.rules: Normal 2000×1000 Modern World, free for all, all countries, no gray tribes. Treasury and troop grants follow the selected balance. These settings are shared by every participant.
modern_lobby.taken: Another participant reserved this country. Choose an available country and try again.
modern_lobby.unsupported: This country is not supported by the room's scenario.
modern_lobby.not_player: Spectators do not reserve countries. Switch to playing to choose one.
modern_lobby.closed: Country selection is closed or this room is not in modern mode.
modern_lobby.not_ready: Every playing participant must reserve a country before the match starts.
modern_lobby.invalid_rules: The room's modern rules or country reservations are invalid. Restore the modern preset and select distinct countries.
